ai.title: Agent Runtime repairs malformed tool call inputs
ai.summary: Tool executor now repairs malformed stringified JSON inputs and surfaces parse errors to agent. Scope includes packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/tool-executor.ts and CI tmux install fallback in .github/workflows/freebuff-e2e.yml. New parseStringifiedToolInput returns { input, parseError }; stringInputError includes parser message.

eli5.text: When the AI assistant tries to use a tool (like running a command or opening a file), it usually sends the instructions as a neatly formatted message. But sometimes, due to quirks in how different AI systems talk to each other, that message gets jumbled up, like a letter sent in the wrong envelope, so the recipient can't understand it. This update teaches the system to recognize those jumbled messages, try to fix them automatically, and, if it still can't make sense of them, clearly tell the assistant what went wrong instead of silently failing. So if you noticed the assistant occasionally struggling with tool usage before, it should now recover gracefully from more of those hiccups.

ai.title: Waiting room ad slot reserves height
ai.summary: Waiting room screen now reserves a fixed-height slot for the ChoiceAdBanner before async ad fetch resolves. Prevents content layout jump when the banner fills. Implemented by exporting CHOICE_AD_BANNER_HEIGHT from choice-ad-banner.tsx and applying it to a wrapper box in waiting-room-screen.tsx. The separator line is replaced by the reserved height placeholder when ads are absent.

eli5.text: When you sit in the waiting room before your assistant responds, the area where an ad banner will appear now holds its space from the moment the screen opens, rather than staying empty and then suddenly expanding once the ad loads. This stops the rest of the text and buttons on the screen from shifting downward when the banner pops in. Anyone watching the waiting room during an ad-supported session notices a smoother, steadier layout. It is live today in the assistant's command-line interface.

ai.title: Remove Claude Code system prompt prefix injection
ai.summary: Removes `CLAUDE_CODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT_PREFIX` and associated request body transformation logic in `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts`. Previously, this injected a specific system prompt block to satisfy Anthropic OAuth authorization checks for Claude 4+ models. Scope limited to SDK model provider and shared constants in `common/src/constants/claude-oauth.ts`. Fetch calls now pass original init objects without parsing/modifying the `system` field.

eli5.text: Starting May 3, 2026, the tool no longer silently inserts a required phrase into your requests when connecting to newer Claude models through Anthropic's OAuth system. Developers building applications using the provider now send your prompts exactly as written, without the extra system-level prefix that was previously added behind the scenes to meet authorization checks. If you relied on that automatic prefix being attached, your requests will now reach the API unmodified, which may change how some integrations behave with Claude 4+ models accessed via OAuth.
